author: BursaMatus
text:
Cisco patched CVE-2026-76418, an ASA/FTD SSL VPN bug already exploited in the wild. No login needed: one crafted request makes the firewall reload. Only setups with secondary auth on a tunnel group are hit. Upgrade, or turn off secondary auth for now.

#Cisco #VPN #InfoSec https://t.co/ZvXByj6aDM
